## In short

Ask for a refund in writing and escalate to DOT.

## How complaints work in this industry

- DOT forwards complaints to the airline. [DOT](https://www.example.gov/complaint)

## Your leverage

- Refund rules apply to cancelled flights. [Rule](https://www.example.gov/rule)

## Traps

- Vouchers can replace cash refunds if you accept them. [Contract](https://www.example.com/legal/contract-of-carriage)

## Scams to watch for

- Fake rebooking lines in search results. [Security page](https://www.example.com/security)
